projects.title: FluxBank
projects.description: A high-contrast dark-mode financial analytics app engineered with electric cobalt accents, tabular numerals, and scannable data visualizations.
projects.overview: Fluxbank is a modern fintech application designed to provide users with a seamless, high-performance banking experience. The project reimagines how people interact with finance by removing unnecessary complexity and replacing it with clarity, speed, intuitive designs, and sophisticated data visualization.
projects.problem: Traditional mobile banking apps bury essential financial insights beneath cluttered menus, low-contrast charts, and fragmented transaction logs, creating high cognitive load when users try to track spending or manage accounts.
projects.solution: Engineered a high-contrast dark-mode interface anchored by electric cobalt accents, tabular numerals, and modular analytics cards—giving users instant clarity over cash flow, real-time spending breakdowns, and frictionless transfers.

projects.title: DashBite
projects.description: A friction-free mobile food delivery platform featuring intuitive restaurant discovery, streamlined cart checkout, and real-time order tracking.
projects.overview: DashBite is a mobile food delivery app designed to make the entire food ordering journey feel simpler and more enjoyable. From discovering a meal to tracking it on the way to your doorstep, the experience brings the entire journey into one cohesive product.
projects.problem: Hungry users frequently abandon food orders due to overwhelming restaurant catalogs, tedious multi-step customization screens, hidden checkout fees, and vague delivery arrival estimates.
projects.solution: Designed a cohesive, conversion-focused mobile ordering journey featuring smart meal discovery, a persistent three-tap cart checkout with transparent pricing, and a live visual courier tracker from kitchen to doorstep.

projects.title: Hirely
projects.description: A crisp light-mode mobile job discovery platform engineered with interactive swipe-to-apply mechanics to eliminate traditional form fatigue.
projects.overview: Hirely is a mobile job finder application designed to eliminate form fatigue and information overload for digital creators. With real-time application tracking, the platform transforms the anxious, clunky process of mobile job hunting into a fluid, transparent, and rewarding experience.
projects.problem: Digital creators face severe form fatigue and information overload on mobile job boards, forced to repeatedly fill out redundant applications only to be left in the dark without status updates.
projects.solution: Built a crisp light-mode mobile experience centered around scannable role cards, one-profile swipe-to-apply gestures, and a transparent real-time application status tracker.

projects.title: Smartlearn
projects.description: An accessible digital education mobile application designed with clear course progression pathways, interactive modules, and distraction-free reading layouts.
projects.overview: SMARTLEARN is an interactive educational app designed to make learning engaging and fun for early stage learners (4–10 years old). The project focuses on creating a joyful, intuitive interface that teaches foundational concepts (animals, numbers, nature) while utilizing gamification to foster motivation, positive reinforcement, and a personalized learning path.
projects.problem: Early-stage learners (ages 4–10) easily lose focus when educational apps rely on text-heavy screens, confusing navigation, and rigid lesson structures that fail to reward curiosity.
projects.solution: Created a joyful, tactile learning environment with visual topic pathways (animals, numbers, nature), large child-friendly touch targets, and gamified positive reinforcement that celebrates every milestone.

projects.title: SpotKick
projects.description: An energetic mobile sports platform balancing live match statistics, dynamic visual hierarchies, and clean component grids.
projects.overview: SpotKick is a mobile football platform designed to make playing football easier, from finding the right pitch to joining a game, paying your share, connecting with teammates, and getting directions to the venue.
projects.problem: Organizing casual football matches is fragmented across group chats, making it difficult for players to discover nearby pitches, confirm open roster spots, split pitch fees, and navigate to venues.
projects.solution: Unified local pitch discovery, one-tap match registration, split-share payments, team chat, and turn-by-turn venue directions into a single high-energy mobile platform.
